If the automatically distributed meal plan doesn't quite fit, you can manually select a dish from your entered dishes instead.

In addition to the flexible meal plan, you can also take control of your freezer. Type in which dishes you have in the freezer, and choose them when you make your meal plan. You can also type in ingredients in your freezer, so when you generate the shopping list for your meal plan, our freezer feature automatically finds which ingredients you already have in the freezer, so you don't spend money on unnecessary items.
